images.two_scrolls_side: Two old parchment scrolls lying side by side on a wooden table in warm candle light, peaceful and humble, no readable letters.
images.row_of_lamps: A long row of glowing oil lamps on a stone wall at dusk, each lamp shining with the same warm light, stretching into the distance.
images.starry_path_hills: A winding path over gentle hills under a starry sky, with soft glowing stones marking the way, calm and guiding.
images.two_trees_one_root: Two olive trees growing from the same root on a sunny hill, branches touching, warm afternoon light, brotherhood.
images.pillows_cozy_room: A cozy children's bedroom at night with two beds, scattered soft pillows and a warm night lamp, nobody present.
images.water_drops_river: Small water drops falling from leaves into a tiny stream that grows into a sparkling river through a green valley, morning light.
